messages:
erin (sec-eng): Heads-up: vendor upload exposed an object that contains a Vault transit blob referencing svc acct partner-ingest@acme.iam.gserviceaccount.com. bucket was briefly public (~11h). tagging @marco @rachel for rotation plan

marco (infra): ack. which vault path + KMS key? any evidence plaintext left the environment?

erin (sec-eng): path: secret/data/partners/acme/etl. wrap key: projects/acme-prod/locations/us-central1/keyRings/partners/cryptoKeys/wrap-v2. object: gs://acme-partner-dumps/2026-03-22/etl-vault.blob (starts with vault:v2:). no internal sa key create events, but treat as P1 for partner scope.

rachel (platform): transit format is good. plan: 1) block partner SA binding (with conditional expiry), 2) create new software KMS key under our tenant, 3) run a dry-run rewrap to a temp secret, 4) swap and rotate downstream credentials, 5) bump log retention for acme-prod to 90d.

tom (oncall): i'll file INC-4410 and schedule a 30m maintenance window at 20:00 PT. i'll monitor service error rate and page infra on sustained 3%+ errors for 5m.

marco (infra): i'll apply a short-lived IAM condition to deny the partner serviceAccount immediately: `gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding acme-prod --member=serviceAccount:partner-ci@acme.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/iam.serviceAccountUser --condition='title=evict,expression=request.time < timestamp("2026-03-23T21:00:00Z")'` then follow up with TF change.

erin (sec-eng): rewrap dry-run snippet (from bastion):

```bash
# dry-run: rewrap to temp path
C=$(vault kv get -field=ciphertext secret/partners/acme/etl)
NEW=$(vault write -field=ciphertext transit/rewrap key=new-partner-wrap ciphertext=$C)
vault kv put secret/temp/partners/acme/etl ciphertext=$NEW
# verify downstream acceptance test
curl -s -X POST https://staging-api.redwood/internal/auth-check -d '{"secret_path":"secret/temp/partners/acme/etl"}'
```

rachel (platform): i'll provision `new-partner-wrap` (software key) and lock IAM to only allow the vault SA and ops infra group. we'll wait to request HSM until legal signs off. setting rotation to 90d after stability. PR for logging retention change queued.

audit-bot: automated notice - IAM policy change detected for partner-ci@acme.iam.gserviceaccount.com at 2026-03-23T18:22:10Z (INC-4410).

marco (infra): snapshot vault before any writes: `vault snapshot save /tmp/pre-rewrap-$(date +%s).snap` and upload to locked bucket for forensics. also run a GCS grep for `Authorization:` and `Bearer` in the 12h window, we may need to rotate tokens printed to logs.

erin (sec-eng): rollback: restore snapshot and reapply old binding if the rewrap/put fails. keep original ciphertext artifacts and metadata for forensics.

tom (oncall): standing by at go-time. will post dry-run results + checklist in INC-4410 and then signal when ready to flip. :thumbsup:
